subject: general
question:
Which part of the following sentence contains a spelling error?

Her monograph (1) on colonial histriography (2) was lauded for its originality, depth, (3) and interdisciplinary methodology. (4)
solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. histriography .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"histriography"** in the sentence is misspelled.
 
• The correct spelling of the word is **"historiography"**, which refers to the study of the writing of history or historical works.
 
• It is important to ensure the correct spelling of technical or academic terms in formal writing to maintain clarity and credibility.

Correct sentence: *Her monograph on colonial **historiography** was lauded for its originality, depth, and interdisciplinary methodology.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Common Spelling Errors:**
 
 
• Double-check for words that are similar in sound but differ in meaning or spelling, such as "histriography" vs. "historiography."
 
• Use a dictionary or spell-checking tools when in doubt about the accuracy of a term.
 
 
 
• **Importance of Proofreading:**
 
 
• Proofreading helps catch spelling, grammar, and punctuation errors that can undermine the quality of a written piece.
 
• Always review academic or professional documents thoroughly before submission.
